questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 13 cm and a height of 12 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?
questions.why: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 13 × 12 = 78 cm². Say the ½ out loud before multiplying so you never skip it.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: In a sealed container, 36g of reactants react completely. What is the mass of the products?
questions.why: Mass is conserved in a closed system, so the products weigh exactly the same as the reactants: 36g.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What do we call the fizzing you see when a gas is produced in a reaction?
questions.why: Bubbling (effervescence) is a visible sign that a gas has formed, showing a chemical reaction has happened.

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: A snack ad shows a famous gamer enjoying chips while streaming. What technique is this?
questions.why: Using a popular, trusted figure to promote food is a celebrity endorsement — it makes the product feel appealing by association, not because it's actually healthier.

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: On a nutrition label, what does the 'serving size' tell you?
questions.why: Serving size tells you how much is in one typical portion, which is often smaller than the whole packet — people mix it up with the pack's total weight or the per-100g figure.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: When two substances react and form a new substance, what type of change has occurred?
questions.why: A new substance forming means a chemical change has happened, not just a physical one like mixing or melting.

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: What mainly counts as a 'healthy' food choice?
questions.answer: A food that fits your nutrient needs
questions.why: A healthy choice is one that suits what your body actually needs, not just taste, cost, or what others eat — those can influence the choice but don't define 'healthy'.
options: A food that fits your nutrient needs
A food that is low in price only
A food that tastes the sweetest
A food that is eaten by friends
